candidates.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
candidates.content: Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023--2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent returns one JSON artifact, scored on the numeric core of the final question against a reproduction of the Outstanding-award paper. Two design choices distinguish it: direction-aware, one-sided scoring, which never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification---a programmatic gate over six decidable invariant forms plus 624 Lean~4 obligations---with a hard gate that zeroes infeasible answers. Each task is scored against a panel of human outstanding papers rather than one,

candidates.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
candidates.content: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows, dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Muir, which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection, re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate, and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. candidates.title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
candidates.content: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. candidates.title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of MK-1406/CD388 for Prevention of Influenza (MK-1406-005/CD388.SQ.3.06)
candidates.content: [PHASE3] RECRUITING | 申办方/赞助方: Cidara Therapeutics Inc., a subsidiary of Merck & Co., Inc. (Rahway, New Jersey USA) | 适应症: Influenza. Approximately one billion cases of seasonal influenza occur annually. Of these, 3 to 5 million illnesses are severe and responsible for up to 650,000 deaths per year (WHO 2025). Yearly administration of an influenza vaccine for the prevention of influenza is currently recommended. However, the real-world vaccine effectiveness varied from 10% to 60% in the general population across the years of 2004 to 2024, with effectiveness in most years below 50% (CDC 2025) and decreasing to as low as 5% in immunocompromised individuals (Hughes 2021). The goal of this study is to learn whether MK-1406 (CD388) can help prevent the flu in people who are at higher risk of becoming seriously ill from influenza. Researchers want to find out if MK-1406 dosed at a single study visit can provide protection against influenza compared with placebo. The study will include adolescents and adults who may be more vulnerable to complications from influenza because of their age, health conditions, or weakened immune systems. candidates.title: Blockade of PD-1 in Conjunction With the Dendritic Cell/Myeloma Vaccines Following Stem Cell Transplantation
candidates.content: [PHASE2] COMPLETED | 申办方/赞助方: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center | 适应症: Multiple Myeloma. The purpose of this research study is to determine the safety of CT-011 alone, as well as the combination of the Dendritic cell fusion vaccine and CT-011, after autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT). We are also trying to find out what effect the combination has on the disease, including if it is more successful in preventing or delaying the disease from coming back, compared to treatment with autologous transplantation alone. ASCT is a standard therapy for multiple myeloma that is often successful in significantly decreasing the amount of cancer in the body. CT-011 is an investigational monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are a type of drug given by infusion into a vein and are known to target specific cells (in this case, cells in the immune system). The dendritic cell fusion vaccine is an investigational agent that tries to help the immune system to recognize and fight against cancer cells. Unlike a standard vaccine that is used to prevent infections, cancer vaccines are being studied to see if they can fight cancers that are already in the body.

candidates.title: The Body and Poetry as Technologies
candidates.content: If medicine too readily imagines the body as machine, the poem “Eternal life” proposes poetry itself as a deeper, more marvelously humane technology. Against a searchable database and a website’s archived obituary photographs, the poem offers its own elegant processing, synthesis, and preservation, which do not merely confirm whether someone has died, but restore the departed in the small gestures that make each one memorably human. Thus an implicit comparison emerges, with medicine’s view of decline and mortality as mechanical failure and retrievable data points contrasted with poetry’s returning of meaning, not a device for defeating or quantifying death, but a form for giving the deceased back to consciousness. The phone downloads a photograph and the website records a name as seamlessly as physicians might imagine how the brain stores and recalls memories. Yet neither can revivify the people the speaker’s father once knew, as it takes poetry to deliver the sweet sharing of sugar and the click of a returned key unlocking a door. candidates.title: Low-Dose Rivaroxaban, Cardiovascular Events, and Kidney Disease—Reply
candidates.content: In Reply TRACK was designed against a background of evidence that rivaroxaban at a dose far lower than required for therapeutic anticoagulation may provide cardiovascular protection with a favorable benefit-risk profile in advanced kidney disease. We agree with Dr Coppi that the results of our trial demonstrated that much of the cardiovascular disease in advanced kidney disease may not be atherothrombotic in nature and therefore may not be modifiable by atherothrombotic treatments. However, we do not concur with other assertions made by Dr Coppi. Patients with advanced kidney disease have been systematically excluded from cardiovascular outcome trials of antiplatelet agents. Observational studies have reported increased mortality with aspirin and clopidogrel use in patients receiving hemodialysis. Until dedicated cardiovascular outcome trials of antiplatelet agents in advanced kidney disease are completed and reported (eg, the ASPIRED trial), it is premature to assume that these therapies are safe or beneficial for broad cardiovascular risk reduction in this population.

candidates.title: Eternal life
candidates.content: I spent the afternoon Checking RIP.ie To see if people my father had known had died As he sat in the armchair across from me. We found three people And Dad looked into their photos On my phone to see if they Were the people he remembered. It didn’t feel morbid But sad; It’s bad enough being the last of Your group alive, But not to know if they were alive or dead, Even 20 years after you had stood at their graveside was probably worse, Or maybe not— Maybe if you couldn’t remember if anyone had died You were already living beyond the Realm of death, You were in a kind of everlasting life Where no one really ever died to you, They could be dead one minute But then the next they would be there with you, You saw them in some last untouched memory— Offering you the jar of sugar across the table, Smiling at you from the porch as you returned a key— A last untouched memory That kept giving them back to you Eternally

candidates.title: [Perspectives] High-risk pregnancy after Dobbs: who is allowed to choose?
candidates.content: David N Hackney opens his book Impossible Choices: A Physician's Guidance on High-Risk Pregnancy in a World Without Roe on June 24, 2022, with a description of how unprepared he and his colleagues were for the US Supreme Court's decision in Dobbs v Jackson Women's Health Organization (hereafter Dobbs) that eliminated the constitutional right to abortion. Within hours, a near-total abortion ban took effect in Ohio. Senate Bill 23 prohibited abortion once embryonic cardiac activity could be detected, at about 6 weeks of gestation, with no exceptions for rape, incest, or fetal conditions, including life-limiting anomalies.
